what_is_measured: I-124 PET dosimetry, Gy delivered to a named lesion
directness_to_rai_effect: direct physical quantity; the actual exposure
notes: Tier 1 is the only tier that measures the exposure itself rather than a consequence. Present in ERRITI (n=20) and in some redifferentiation trial arms. Absent from every public omics dataset we hold.

what_is_measured: I-123 or I-131 scintigraphy read as uptake present/absent at a named site
gse151179: yes (rai uptake at the metastatic site, Yes 25 / No 27)
e_mtab_12837_12900: yes (redifferentiation response, defined as restored uptake)
liu2024: yes (RAI uptake present 21 / absent 27; loss at first I-131)
redifferentiation_trials: yes (all 9 arms; this is the pooled endpoint)
notes: The best endpoint available to us in public data. GSE151179 and Liu 2024 both carry it at patient level. Definition of "uptake" is not harmonised across sources.

what_is_measured: thyroglobulin trajectory after I-131, stimulated or suppressed
directness_to_rai_effect: consequence of RAI, confounded by tumour burden and TSH state
notes: Tg is exposure-adjacent but not exposure. Borowczyk 2024 (n=646, germline) uses stimulated Tg as the RAI response variable; that is the largest RAI-response-annotated cohort found all day.

tier_label: Structural response by RECIST after RAI
what_is_measured: imaging response of measurable disease following RAI
directness_to_rai_effect: consequence of RAI, but competing therapies contaminate
notes: RECIST after RAI conflates RAI with any concurrent systemic therapy. In DECISION every patient was already refractory, so RECIST there measures sorafenib, not RAI.

what_is_measured: RAIR label by ATA 2015 criteria or local equivalent
notes: This is the tier most public datasets sit at. It is a composite of tiers 2-4 plus judgement, which is why cross-cohort meta-analysis on it carries high heterogeneity (driver-axis meta I-squared = 63%).

tier_label: Treatment response code in a registry
directness_to_rai_effect: course-specific, not RAI-specific unless the course is filtered
tcga_thca: yes (per RAI course; index-course rules required)
notes: TCGA-THCA only. Empirically course-specific (values change within patient across courses), so an index-course rule is mandatory before use. Five rules tested; all give the same null.

what_is_measured: new tumour event, residual disease, tumour status at last follow-up, PFS, OS
directness_to_rai_effect: prognostic within treated patients; not attributable to RAI without an untreated comparator
tcga_thca: yes (new tumour event 9/136; residual disease 13/59; tumour status 34/182)
notes: The tier where our only significant TCGA results live (OR 0.221 and 0.224). Cannot be called RAI-predictive: the treatment-by-score interaction is unestimable (2 events among non-RAI-treated).
